text:
maya: quick flag 1 1: the new price-sheet rollout (cohort D, variant 'delta-v1') appears to have double-applied charges for customers who converted plans during the 08:00-08:15 UTC window. noticed ~9 accounts with overlapping invoice lines.
ben: yikes. are these full duplicates or different line items (legacy + new)?
maya: looks like both: legacy subscription lines plus new metered lines for the same usage window. sample invoice INV-20260323-2211 shows subscription and metered charges that should be mutually exclusive.
liam: can you paste the quick query you ran?
maya: ran:
```sql
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, COUNT(*) as lines, SUM(amount_usd) as total
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-23T08:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-23T08:30:00Z'
  AND price_variant IN ('legacy','delta-v1')
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 50;
```
priya: results returned 9 accounts, mostly small amounts but one ~ $1.2k.
sara: finance: we need approval to pause cohort routing and to issue interim credits for duplicates <= $200 automatically. larger ones escalate.
ben: approve automated credits up to $200 per account for immediate cleanup. >$200 escalate to finance lead.
liam: product flag is `pricing_router.delta_v1_enabled`. I can toggle. Ops: please hold writes to invoice_lines for delta-v1 in region eu-west while we triage.
ops-bot: applying write-lock for price_sheet delta-v1 in eu-west (lock token lock-2034123456). TTL 20m.
maya: opening FIN ticket FIN-4750 for the affected accounts list and tagging billing ops. sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/delta-rollout-dupes
priya: vendor-ops: can you check if webhook replay or delayed events caused duplicate usage?
vendor-ops: looking; will report within 15m.
liam: quick mitigation: flip cohort back to legacy for eu-west while we confirm. I can flip now if finance still ok.
ben: go ahead with flip. prioritize minimizing customer impact.
liam: flipped `pricing_router.delta_v1_enabled` -> false at 2026-03-23T08:13:42Z. verifying routing...
liam: smoke-check: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_routing WHERE variant='delta-v1' AND region='eu-west'; -> 0.
sara: billing ops queued dedupe job with merge-threshold $200 and credit template. creating FIN-4751..FIN-4759 per account.
priya: vendor-ops reports some duplicate webhook deliveries due to transient 504s from our endpoint at 08:05-08:12 UTC. root likely vendor retries + our ingest not deduping on request_id. INF-3385 created.
ops-bot: INF-3385: "ingest: ensure idempotent handling of vendor webhooks" assigned to eng-infra.
ben: next steps: 1) credits issued for <=$200 accounts (authorized), 2) manual review for $1.2k account, 3) add dedupe guard in ingest, 4) postmortem and update rollout SOP to pause grandfathering jobs for 5m during flips.
maya: will run reconciliation and post net-revenue impact by EOD. leaving thread open until done.
ops-bot: archival reminder: this thread will auto-archive in 90 days.
